work: Draft rooms — bridge, storm window band; wet_lab, slanting pipe bank; dry_lab, monitor grid; mess_hall, circle of mugs; medical_bay, white examination bed; crew_quarters, eight doorways; editing_room, little monitor wall; engineering_workshop, low view of tall racks. Draft people — thomas_blake, reclining suit; sarah_morgan, square shoulders; maya_chen, face-on portrait in warm light; daniel_reyes, stooped and wiping his hands; olivia_hart, seated crescent; lucas_weber, sideways with a hand in motion. First comparison across 28 room pairs and 15 portrait pairs. Wet_lab and engineering_workshop shared three axes and a low, hard-lit view of machinery. I moved the workshop view to a corner and confined its light to the bench. Dry_lab and editing_room shared two axes and both read as monitor walls. I gave the editing room a foreground knot of headphones and charging leads, with light from several devices. Thomas_blake and maya_chen shared three axes and both appeared to address the viewer. I brought Maya in closer, softened the light and turned her attention just beside the viewer. Sarah_morgan and daniel_reyes shared two axes. I confined Daniel’s light to his hands and chest so Sarah kept the sharply lit shoulder line. Second comparison across all pairs. The closest room pairs share two axes each. Bridge and dry_lab share blue and ordered equipment. Dry_lab and crew_quarters share darkness and order. Crew_quarters and engineering_workshop share darkness and vertical forms. Mess_hall and engineering_workshop share a corner view and pooled light. Their thumbnail cues are a storm horizon, a monitor grid, receding doors, tall racks and a round table. No portrait pair shares more than one axis. Use the same fine ink contours, broken hatching and wet-edged grey wash throughout, with one restrained accent per image.

rooms.description: From the doorway, a broad strip of salt-streaked windows silhouettes the low, bolted console against a heaving grey sea. Blue radar and weather displays punctuate the dark line beside a radio handset and clipped log sheets.
rooms.feeling: Alert and exposed, with the sea pressing close.

rooms.description: From knee height, a diagonal bank of teal seawater hoses climbs past steel benches toward a clamped sampling manifold. Hard ceiling strips glint on pump housings, crowded clear sample bottles and puddles stippling the anti-slip floor.
rooms.feeling: Humid and relentless, with the pumps audible in the image.

rooms.description: At seated height, a grid of blue monitors faces squarely forward above a straight bolted desk. Thin plots and blank axes glow across aligned keyboards and neat stacks of scientific notes, leaving the outer wall dark.
rooms.feeling: Hushed and cool, with the concentration of a room built for long shifts.

rooms.description: From a corner, a round bolted table fills the foreground under an amber lamp, its rim dotted with mismatched mugs. Behind it, a coffee pot, a latched refrigerator and curling noticeboard scraps crowd the little galley.
rooms.feeling: Warm and familiar, as if someone has just stepped away from breakfast.

rooms.description: Seen from above, the white examination bed spans the room beneath a broad diffused ceiling panel. Closed green cabinets with flush catches line one bulkhead, and a compact diagnostic screen sits beside a cleared report desk.
rooms.feeling: Clean, composed and slightly too quiet.

rooms.description: At eye level, eight narrow cabin doors recede in two ranks of four toward a blank bulkhead. One ajar door spills soft yellow light over a glimpse of quilt, worn thresholds and a continuous handrail.
rooms.feeling: Private and close, with a trace of warmth from behind a door.

rooms.description: Over the shoulder of a high-backed chair, headphone coils and charging leads bunch around two cameras on a shallow desk. A tilted laptop, paired monitors and charger LEDs wash pinned shot diagrams in faint violet.
rooms.feeling: Absorbed and restless, like an edit paused mid-cut.

rooms.description: From the corner, red parts drawers stack to the overhead beside a wall of hanging spanners. A guarded work light pools across a scarred bench, catching meter leads, a clipped maintenance diagram and a squat terminal.
rooms.feeling: Cramped, loud and busy with repairs.

people.description: Tall and narrow, he leans back in a sharply tailored navy jacket, a violet pocket square catching the light. A long face and swept silver hair frame a practiced smile as he rolls a capped pen.
people.feeling: Personable and polished, with impatience showing in the pen.

people.description: Broad and compact, she stands square in a zipped blue shipboard uniform, her hands clasped behind her. Hard side light catches her close-cropped curls and blunt jaw as she looks steadily just past the viewer.
people.feeling: Steady authority, with each word considered before she speaks.

people.description: Slight and narrow-shouldered, she leans forward, a loose yellow fleece broadening toward her folded hands at the frame edge. Soft light catches her low black ponytail, round cheeks and tired eyes as she glances toward the speaker.
people.feeling: Approachable and attentive, holding her composure through fatigue.

people.description: Stocky and hunched, he juts both elbows out to wipe grease from his knuckles with a rag. Bench light catches the orange seams of his coveralls, his stubbled jaw and wiry hair as he looks down.
people.feeling: Tired and matter-of-fact, still working while he talks.

people.description: Long-necked and fine-boned, she sits in a fitted sage scrub top, her shoulder and bent arm forming an arc. Diffuse light catches her oval face and tucked auburn bob as a fingertip rests against her cheek.
people.feeling: Quietly attentive, comfortable letting a pause last.

people.description: Lanky, he twists sideways into the close crop, the red hood of his loose sweatshirt slanting off one shoulder. Backlight rims his messy blond curls as his freckled face tilts up and splayed fingers punctuate a question.
people.feeling: Quick, friendly curiosity that keeps tugging the conversation forward.
